title: A reflective infographic exploring the overlap between systems thinking and existential inquiry. This piece examines pattern recognition, integration, curiosity, and the tendency to seek underlying structures in both technology and human experience. A reminder that some minds are naturally drawn to understanding how things fit together—not only in systems, but in meaning, identity, and life itself. #systems-thinking #engineering-mindset #consciousness #personal-growth #self-awareness
